pooling.interpretation: The three seeds use one physical feature tape; they are not independent recordings or sessions.
pooling.live_formula: sum cumulative block SSE across seeds divided by summed feature target counts across seeds
pooling.probe_formula: 100 * (pooled checkpoint-0 MSE - pooled current MSE) / pooled checkpoint-0 MSE for each arm

units.x: minutes on the monitoring sample clock
